## Triage: first touch → `domain:skills` · p2 · 2026-11-15T01:45Z

⛔ Not a claim.

A carried contract-review record can survive a hop that renamed a reviewed file out of the reviewed face, because the hop's rename is listed by its destination only. This weakens a review gate, so it is tooling **p2** (`--no-renames`, or list both sides).

## Added scope from the at-tier delta 6887748912 of PR #33531

The older real-git fixtures in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` spawn `git` with no `GIT_` strip (the file has no `gitFreeEnv` reference), against `GIT_ENV_ISOLATION_RULE` in `scripts/git-env.mjs`. Under an inherited `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_WORK_TREE` or `GIT_INDEX_FILE` (a hook, `rebase --exec`) they would act on the real checkout. PR #33531 fixed its own new case (SF3: `env: gitFreeEnv()` plus `-c commit.gpgsign=false`); give the older fixtures the same in the PR for this card, since both are carry-machinery hygiene in `scripts/pm/**`.
